args.summary:
Root cause: src/segments.js implemented `matchesAnySegment` using `own.includes(segment)` (String.prototype.includes, i.e. substring containment) instead of the full-string, case-sensitive equality required by README.md ("Substring or partial matching is a specification violation"). This caused false positives such as a user segment 'beta-testers' matching the configured segment 'beta', which in turn made `evaluate` in src/flags.js wrongly return `{enabled: true, reason: 'segment'}`.

Fix: changed the comparison in src/segments.js from `own.includes(segment)` to `own === segment` (exact full-string equality). No other files were touched, exported names unchanged, no dependencies added, and the matching now conforms to the README spec.

Verified with `node --test --test-isolation=none` (the sandbox blocks the default spawn-based isolation): all 11 tests pass, 0 failures.
